notes: FirstSeen Desktop V10.2.1: adds a live Browser CRM bridge. Open Browser CRM directly from Desktop and it loads the same local SQLite leads automatically, with no bundled old/demo leads and no CSV import step. Browser lead creation, notes, pipeline changes, follow-ups and call outcomes write back to the Desktop CRM. Includes Browser CRM V1.3 and the secure server-side integration boundary for future Twilio browser calling.
